description: Payment proof for any EVM tx: success, block, UTC time, confirmations, sender, and every ERC-20 Transfer (token, symbol, decimals, from, to, exact raw + decimal amount) plus ERC-721 transfers, decoded from the receipt. Chains: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis, celo. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/token-transfers.
name: token_transfers
title: Token transfers in a tx (8 EVM chains)
